item_name: Sabre 3-In-1 Pepper Spray With Plastic Case
item_short_desc: SABRE’s 3-In-1 Pepper Spray provides advanced protection in a convenient, easy-to-carry design. This powerful pepper spray combines 3 effective components: red pepper, CS tear gas, and UV marking dye, offering maximum defense against potential threats. The compact plastic case features a quick-release keychain, ensuring that you can access the spray swiftly in any situation. With approximately 25 shots per canister and an effective range of 8-10 feet, this pepper spray delivers reliable performance when you need it most.
